blocks.text: Aik coil battery, switch aur rheostat ke saath series mein juri hai (Fig 17.18). Agar rheostat tezi se hilaya jaye to coil se current badalta hai, is liye coil se magnetic flux badalta hai, jo khud coil mein emf paida karta hai.

blocks.alt: Lambi coil jo switch, battery aur rheostat ke saath series mein hai; current I circuit mein ghoomta. Primary current ki magnetic field lines coil se guzarti hain, chakkaron ke gird chhote gol teer. Labels primary current, aik chakkar mein induced current aur coil par induced emf dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.18: Coil khud apne andar induced current aur induced emf paida karti hui (kitab ki Figure 17.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rheostat tezi se hilane par current badalta hai, is liye coil ka apna flux badalta hai aur usi coil mein ulti emf (induced emf) paida hoti hai. Yeh emf current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalfat karti hai; isi ko self-induction kehte hain.

blocks.title: Self-induction
blocks.text: Self-induction woh mazhar hai jis mein badalta current khud coil mein emf paida karta hai.

Farz karein phi coil ke aik chakkar se flux hai; N chakkaron se flux N phi hai. Kyunke phi magnetic field ke mutanasib hai, jo current I ke mutanasib hai, N phi, I ke mutanasib hai: N phi = LI (17.29), jahan constant L coil ki self-inductance hai. L chakkaron ki tadaad, coil ke cross-section ke raqbe aur markaz (core) ke maddah par munhasir hai: coil ko ferromagnetic lohe ke markaz par lapetne se flux, aur yun inductance, hawa ke markaz ke muqable bohat barh jati hai.

Faraday ke qanoon se paida shuda emf eL = -N d(phi)/dt (17.30) = -d(N phi)/dt = -d(LI)/dt, is liye eL = -L dI/dt (17.31), ya L = -eL / (dI/dt) (17.32). Manfi nishan batata hai ke paida shuda emf current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalfat karti hai (Lenz ka qanoon). 17.30 aur 17.31 barabar karne se L = N d(phi)/dI (17.33) bhi milta hai.

blocks.title: Henry
blocks.text: Coil ki self-inductance 1 henry (H) hai agar us mein current 1 A s^-1 ki sharah se badalne par 1 V emf paida ho. Self-inductance ki SI ikai V s A^-1 (henry) hai, jis ke dimensions [M L^2 T^-2 A^-2] hain.

Aik coil ki 50 Hz par inductive reactance 160 ohm hai. Is ki self-inductance maloom karein. Hal: XL = 2 pi f L, is liye L = XL / (2 pi f) = 160 ohm / (2 x 3.14 x 50 Hz) = 0.509 H. (Kitab ki data lakeer frequency 59 Hz chhapti hai; hal 50 Hz istemal karta hai.)

Aik coil battery aur switch se juri hai (Fig 17.19). Switch band karne par current sifar se aakhri qeemat I tak barhta, aur badalta current battery ke ulat emf paida karta hai; battery ko is ke khilaf charge le jane ka kaam karna parta hai. Chhota charge dq le jane ka kaam W = dq eL (17.34), eL = L dI/dt ke saath, is liye W = dq L (dI/dt) = (dq/dt) L dI (17.35). Yahan dq/dt aust current, (0 + I)/2 = I/2, aur dI = I - 0 = I. Is liye W = (I/2) L I = (1/2) L I^2 (17.36). Yeh kaam magnetic field mein potential energy ki shakal mein jama hota hai: Um = (1/2) L I^2 (17.37). Yeh kabhi manfi nahi ho sakti, kyunke current ke square par munhasir hai; current barhte waqt inductor tawanai leta aur ghatte waqt wapas karta hai.

blocks.alt: Switch ke zariye battery se juri coil; current I coil ke aik sire mein jata aur doosre se nikalta. Coil ke dono siron se magnetic field lines phailti hain. Mura hua surkh teer induced current dikhata hai jo I ke barhne ki mukhalfat karta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.19: Inductor mein jama tawanai maloom karne ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Fi ikai lambai n chakkar, cross-section A aur lambai l wale solenoid ke liye B = mu_o n I aur L = mu_o n^2 A l. Rakhne se Um = (1/2) mu_o n^2 A l (B / mu_o n)^2 = (B^2 / 2 mu_o)(A l), jahan A l hajm hai. Is liye magnetic field ki energy density Um / hajm = B^2 / (2 mu_o) (17.38) hai.

blocks.title: Is husool ki chhapi ghaltiyan
blocks.text: Kitab aust current (0 + I)/2 ki jagah (0 + 1)/2 likhti, N phi = LI (17.29) ke liye 'Eq 17.28' ka hawala deti, aur equation 17.38 mein durust B^2/(2 mu_o) dene se pehle aakhri qadam B^2/mu_o chhapti hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 A wale 0.5 H inductor mein kitni tawanai jama hai?

items: Self-induction: N phi = LI; eL = -L dI/dt (tabdeeli ki mukhalfat).
L chakkaron, raqbe aur markaz par munhasir; 1 H = 1 V s A^-1.
Tawanai Um = (1/2) L I^2; energy density B^2/(2 mu_o).
